kind: multi-panel webcomic (raster PNG, line art, hand-lettered dialogue)

requiredButtons.mustExposeTitleText: Her daughter is named Help I'm trapped in a driver's license factory.
requiredButtons.why: The title attribute (hover text) is part of the comic; sighted users see it on hover.

textView.notes: Linked banners are site chrome. They may become buttons (no site-specific rules allowed), but the comic must come first in reading order.

tactile.coordinateSpace: source pixels [x0, y0, x1, y1]; tolerance 6 px

overview1x.fit: image fills the 96-pin width; height about 30 of the 35 canvas rows
overview1x.panelBorders: 4 closed rectangles in left-to-right order, 1 pin wide
overview1x.gutters: at least 1 blank pin column between each pair of adjacent panel borders
overview1x.textAsPins: none: dialogue lettering is not drawn as pins at 1x; it is read through labels and the caption rows
overview1x.backgroundPins: none outside panel interiors and borders
overview1x.strokes: every ink stroke (figure, furniture, phone squiggle, speech tail) becomes ONE 1-pin centerline, never a doubled outline of the stroke's two edges
drawings: Mom in each panel as a stick figure: head outline with hair, torso line, two arms, two legs; each limb a continuous line; figure about 15 pins tall
phone at her head as a small mark touching the head outline
Panel 1 and Panel 2 tables: tabletop plus legs as vertical lines, clearly separate from Mom (>= 1 blank pin between them)
mug: at 1x may merge into the hand or tabletop; steam squiggles are dropped at 1x
phone-voice zigzags and speech tails: kept only if they fit under the fill limit; dropped before figures or furniture
overview1x.deviceCheck: By touch: count 4 panels left to right without lifting the finger off the top border.

isolatePanel3.expect: Panel 3 alone, re-fit to the 96x35 canvas (Mom about 30 pins tall); head, hair, the phone held to her ear, torso, arms and legs are distinguishable lines; the two dialogue zones are separate touch regions without pins; fill <= 0.25
isolatePanel3.back: Back returns to the 1x overview with Panel 3 still selected

zoom.expect: Figure outlines get more detail, fill stays <= 0.25, lines stay continuous when panning across the viewport edge

each child lies inside its panel box
reading order: p1, p2, p3, p4; inside a panel, top to bottom
finger on any pin of a component gives its label within one 25 ms poll, with a 30 ms vibration on entry

all edits kept (stored by image content hash, so the same image on another page reuses them)
